data.relation_cache_hash_kind: sha256 over sorted (key,dtype,shape,bytes) content, machine independent

architecture.name: BOSI-v0
architecture.initialisation: atom/bond encoders from train-only masked-SSL checkpoint; every other module from a single shared seed stream

arms.R: true per-relation partition of partner moments
arms.B: same relation counts, same leave-one-out partner total, allocated proportionally to counts (protocol amendment A1)
arms.Bfull_not_trained: DESIGN literal n/deg * sum over all incident bonds; CPU diagnostic only

recipe.normalisation: fit_only_norm over the 8000 Fit8k rows, identical arrays for R and B

baseline_history.model: DCC-L (DualChannel L arm, P3 train-only masked-SSL initialisation)

decision_rules.PERFORMANCE_PROMISING: R beats historical DCC-L on Locked in both seeds; seed-mean Locked gain >= 0.005; ordinary and any-unseen both non-negative; sign survives dropping the 10 worst paired molecules; not tail-dominated
decision_rules.STRUCTURE_MECHANISM_ONLY: R beats B in both seeds with seed-mean gain >= 0.003 but does not beat DCC-L; no automatic attention follow-up
decision_rules.NO_GO: R not better than B, or clearly worse than DCC-L, or the effect is unstable / tail-only
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: two seeds or the intervals cannot separate the key comparisons; no extra seeds, no split change

analysis.support_source: Fit8k only; exact typed radius-2 rooted signatures
analysis.top10_sensitivity: drop the 10 molecules with the largest max(AE_A, AE_B) for each pair
analysis.bootstrap: paired over fixed Locked molecules, 10000 resamples, descriptive only

forbidden: official test or official valid access
using Monitor or Locked labels for architecture / hyper-parameter / epoch / seed selection beyond the declared Monitor rule
extra seeds beyond two per model
widening the network, adding moment orders, or changing relation types to bypass a failure
